name: Elbow Dislocation
definition: Displacement of the ulnohumeral/radiocapitellar articulation, commonly posterior, with risk of ligament injury, fracture and neurovascular compromise.

investigations.MRI: CT is useful for fracture-dislocations; MRI is rarely acute.
investigations.radiographs: AP/lateral elbow radiographs confirm reduction and fracture.

green: Short immobilization followed by early ROM when stable
amber: Persistent instability or complex fracture-dislocation needs surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Kurpara-sandhi dislocation phenotype may be documented after orthopedic stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Displacement of the ulnohumeral/radiocapitellar articulation, commonly posterior, with risk of ligament injury, fracture and neurovascular compromise.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
